osaka_sushi_hamuro.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: soy sauce and simmered dishes throughout an omakase.
osaka_sushi_hamuro.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi and seafood counter.
osaka_sushi_hamuro.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); closed Sundays, open holidays, plus irregular days (Tabelog). Hard to reserve (January 2026). Cards accepted (Tabelog).
osaka_sushi_hamuro.notes: [Sushi · a six-seat alley counter off Shinsaibashi-suji] A six-seat sushi counter at the end of a narrow alley, where only the sign shows from the street. It's been open since 2015, and the owner has thirty years of experience. The meal is an omakase of seasonal fish, sushi and small dishes, and you can add favorites. Diners remember the kohada (one called it the best ever), sweet red sea urchin, nodoguro, katsuo tataki, crab, and winter fugu milt. It finishes with ushiojiru. The chef pairs sake to the food. The owner is gentle and the room calm, and regulars keep it full; reservations are hard to get. Courses are good value, drinks less so. Reviewers spent about ¥10,000–30,000.

chef_bio.background: Owner with 30 years of experience (April 2024 review).

anecdotes.text: "The crab, nodoguro (blackthroat sea perch), and katsuo (skipjack tuna) tataki were incredible… The kohada (gizzard shad) was the best I've ever had." — September 2024.
"The owner has a gentle demeanor, making it a comfortable place to enjoy a leisurely meal. I ordered the omakase and added a few of my favorite dishes." — December 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ(店舗会員): 鮓 羽室、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-6-19、心斎橋駅4B出口・なんば駅14番出口から徒歩5分、月〜土17:00〜23:00(L.O.22:30)、日曜休み(祝日は営業)、不定休あり、カード可、6席、2015年3月31日開店。口コミ(2022年9月〜2026年5月): 常連の多い隠れ家、江戸前の鮨、赤うに、路地の奥に看板だけ、経験30年の主人、刺身の盛り合わせ、赤貝・中トロ・鯛、蟹・のどぐろ・鰹のたたき、大将が選ぶ日本酒、最高のこはだ、締めの潮汁、ホタルイカ、ソフトシェルクラブ、白魚、焼き蛤、鯛のあら炊き、トロとたくあん、小鯵、穏やかな主人、おまかせに好みを追加、鮨懐石、飲み物は高め、コースは割安、予約が取りにくい、蟹、ふぐの白子。

cultural_comfort.note: Six-seat counter with regulars; reservations needed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing current (staff-maintained); newest review May 2026.

osaka_misono_hozenji.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: kara-age, simmered and sauced dishes.
osaka_misono_hozenji.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reserve: fills within minutes (December 2025). Cards accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog).
osaka_misono_hozenji.notes: [Japanese · a chicken specialist beside Hōzenji] A chicken restaurant in the building next to Mizukake Fudō, cooking domestically raised young chickens from sashimi to rice. The assorted chicken sashimi is fresh and bouncy, the thigh tataki hits hard with garlic, and the kara-age, especially the crisp wings, is a favorite; one diner ordered four plates of grilled cartilage. Look also for fried chicken skin rolled with green onion, liver, gizzards and a spicy simmered chicken skin to eat over rice. Courses run to mizutaki, refined in chicken flavor, with rice porridge, and there is a dry curry omurice. Service is quiet but kind, with plates split for groups. Seats fill within minutes, so reserve. Sake is limited; beer and shochu are there.

chef_bio.background: Chicken specialist using domestically raised young chickens; official site tori-misono.com (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "The sashimi was fresh and had a nice bounce. The kara-age was juicy with a strong meaty flavor… The tataki was robust with a great garlic kick." — October 2025.
"We started with chicken breast and wings, followed by a delicious mizutaki (chicken hot pot). The refined flavor of the chicken in the mizutaki was outstanding." — March 2026, course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式 tori-misono.com。食べログ(店舗会員): みその、大阪市中央区難波1-2-10 法善寺MEOUTOビル1F、法善寺水掛不動尊の隣のビル、月〜土17:00〜22:30(L.O.22:00)、日曜休み、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、国産の若鶏を使った鶏料理の専門店。口コミ(2025年2月〜2026年3月): 誕生日にコース、刺身・手羽先・ドライカレー、カウンターと座敷、なんこつ唐揚げ、鶏刺し、手羽先唐揚げ、レバー焼き、ドライカレーオムライス、サラダ、レバー煮、鶏皮、チゲ、日本酒の種類は少なめ、焼酎、奥の個室のテーブル、刺身は新鮮で弾力、ジューシーな唐揚げ、にんにくの効いたたたき、ねぎを巻いた鶏皮揚げ、取り分けてくれる、ピリ辛の鶏皮煮とご飯、焼きなんこつ4皿、予約なしで入れたがすぐ満席、刺身の盛り合わせ、砂肝、口数は少ないが親切、コースの水炊きと雑炊。

osaka_yakitori_jin_souemoncho.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: tare-glazed skewers; seasoning not described.
osaka_yakitori_jin_souemoncho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken skewers and chicken broth.
osaka_yakitori_jin_souemoncho.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 18:00–3:00 am; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Six counter seats; call ahead (2016 review). Cash only: no cards or e-money (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog).
osaka_yakitori_jin_souemoncho.notes: [Yakitori · a six-seat back-alley counter in Souemoncho] A tiny yakitori counter so deep in a Souemoncho back alley that one diner would never have found it unaided. The current owner took over in January 2014 and kept the name. Skewers are generous and thick: bonjiri, skin, negima, tsukune and yagen nankotsu are favorites. The house draw for some is the chicken liver sashimi, cooked at low temperature. Also on the board: thigh tataki, gizzard, red sausage, a spicy yam kimchi, smashed cucumber, and a chazuke in chicken broth to finish. It's a proper old-school local joint. One diner waited a while for orders. Only six seats, so call ahead. Open until 3 am; closed Sundays. Cash only.

chef_bio.origin: Current owner took over 11 January 2014, keeping the name (Tabelog)

anecdotes.text: "When I think of Jin, I can't help but crave… liver sashimi! It's cooked at a low temperature, and the texture is so amazing that I always want more!" — September 2023.
"The interior is cozy, with about five counter seats, making it easy to connect with the chef." — October 2026.

osaka_isshin_hozenji.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: soy sauce, tare on eel (uzaku).
osaka_isshin_hozenji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi counter. A kabocha maki was once on the menu (2016); ask.
osaka_isshin_hozenji.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 17:00–22:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). Cards accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog).
osaka_isshin_hozenji.notes: [Sushi · a ten-seat counter by Hōzenji's Mizukake Fudō] A long-established sushi counter in the Hōzenji lanes, close to Mizukake Fudō, with ten seats and the calm air of a long-established shop. The head chef is particular about fish, and once turned away a red clam that wasn't fresh enough. Blue crab is a long-running highlight. A July 2026 dinner ran from sashimi and rock oysters to uzaku, an abalone gunkan and tekka maki, with Kamo Tsuru Gold sake, which carries petal-shaped gold leaf. Stories of the shop's history come with the meal. It is pricey: reviewers spent ¥15,000–30,000, and one walk-in felt the bill outran the value. Closed Mondays.

anecdotes.text: "I actually wanted to order my favorite red clam, but it was deemed not fresh enough upon opening, so I couldn't have it… This time, the standout ingredient was the blue crab." — February 2024.
"We also enjoyed a unique Japanese sake, Kamo Tsuru Gold, which features cherry blossom petal-shaped pure gold leaf." — July 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ(店舗会員): 一心法善寺、大阪市中央区難波1-1-8、なんば駅から徒歩5分、火〜日17:00〜22:00、月曜休み、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、カウンター10席、20人まで貸切可。口コミ(2015年6月〜2026年7月): 渡り蟹、トロ鉄火の持ち帰り、目の前で握る、かぼちゃ巻き、老舗の落ち着いた雰囲気、予約なしで値段と内容が見合わないと感じた声、若い大将、最初の3品はおいしかった、いくらは残念、魚の目利き、鮮度が足りない赤貝は出さない、高め、刺身、岩牡蠣、うざく、鮑の軍艦、鉄火巻き、Kamo Tsuru Gold(金箔入り)、水掛不動のそば、店の歴史の話。

osaka_yakiniku_p_takanosuke.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: marinated meats and yukhoe sauce; miso with the senmai.
osaka_yakiniku_p_takanosuke.hours_raw: Daily 18:00–2:00 am; closing days may vary (Tabelog); one diner noted 3 am (February 2025). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog).
osaka_yakiniku_p_takanosuke.notes: [Yakiniku · a six-seat alley counter where the master grills] A hidden yakiniku counter in a narrow Souemoncho alley, next door to Hiromiya. There are no grills at the seats: the master grills each cut and serves it at its best, so up to about seven diners squeeze in close. Portions are about half the usual size, so you can try many cuts. Start with white senmai, when there is any, with sesame oil, salt and a moreish miso. Then go to aburi yukke, wagyu tataki, salted tongue, outside skirt and kalbi. A Korean-style cold tofu with kimchi and seaweed is a side. It's easy to drop by alone, and the owner suits the room. Open late, to 2 am. Cash only; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Counter yakiniku; the owner grills for guests (2022–2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: "The master cooks and serves the meat, so there are no grills on the tables… Each serving is smaller than average, at about half the size of portions in other restaurants, allowing you to try a variety of dishes." — September 2024.
"Both the yukke and tataki were incredibly fresh and delicious! What's more, the owner grills the meat for you!" — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ(店舗会員): 焼肉P貴之助、大阪市中央区宗右衛門町6-25、なんば駅から徒歩5分、毎日18:00〜翌2:00、休みは変わることも、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、カウンター6席、20人まで貸切可、喫煙可。口コミ(2022年12月〜2026年8月): 細い路地の隠れ家、一人でも入りやすい、ユッケとハラミ、焼き加減がちょうどいい、見た目より味の多彩なメニュー、白センマイは数が少ない、朝3時まで、カウンターのみ、マスターが焼いてくれる、韓国風冷奴、センマイ刺しにごま油と塩、味噌、塩タン、ほほ、ミノ、旧清流会館とホテルの隣の路地、ヒロミヤの隣、7人ほどで満席、量は半分ほどで品数を楽しめる、炙りユッケ、和牛たたき、和牛カルビ。
